title: Meet Alice Kim
subtitle: Licensed Professional Counselor
bio:
As a Brazilian-Korean-American therapist, I offer culturally sensitive care tailored to your unique background, values, and goals. My practice is built on honesty, compassion, and evidence-based approaches. Working collaboratively, I help clients reconnect with their strengths, process difficult experiences, and create meaningful change.

Outside of the therapy room, I enjoy playing music, cooking, and spending time with my family and our funny cat, Linus.

items.item: M.A. in Clinical Mental Health, Northwestern University
